lessons_used: Evidence for specific kinds of changes is still thin, as each category has only one completed test so far.
Predictions have consistently been too high compared to measured results.
No clear effect was seen for reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder).
No clear effect was seen for introducing new flows on the home screen (home, new_flow).
No clear effect was seen for redesigning pet selection cards (adoption, redesign).
Redesigning the finish step (finish, redesign) significantly hurt performance.

candidates.title: Interactive Story Introduction Split Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the initial story screen into a split layout showcasing an animated pet mascot reacting on the desktop to immediately set expectations.
candidates.why: The choose_path step loses 23.8% of users right at the beginning and has a long mean duration of 514s.

story.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Your pet lives right on your desktop screen, reacting to your daily activity and bringing life to your workflow.

guard.reason: Redesigns story screen while preserving its core job of introducing the pet.

candidates.score_note: Redesign carries execution risk and lacks support email evidence.

candidates.title: Clear Path Option Time Estimate
candidates.change: Add an explicit time estimate display and helpful hint on the path selection screen.
candidates.why: Median time spent on choose_path is 8s while mean time is 514s, indicating significant user hesitation or idle drop-off.

choose_path.hint: Creating your desktop pet takes less than 2 minutes.

guard.reason: Adds path selection time estimate and hint without altering pricing or core screen job.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy tweak targeting initial step drop-off.

candidates.title: Account Persistence and Sync Warning Note
candidates.change: Add a prominent hint warning users to sign in with their main account to lock in pet data and prevent accidental pet resets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 separate tickets reporting pets missing or reset after signing back into the app.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your primary account to keep your pet save file synchronized safely.

guard.reason: Adds account persistence hint to sign-in screen without violating dark pattern rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong support ticket evidence backed by quick config hint change.

candidates.title: Compact Sign In Screen Layout
candidates.change: Reframe the sign-in screen using a compact layout focus to reduce visual clutter and prevent sign-in stalling.
candidates.why: Sign-in loses 27.1% of onboarding users with a high mean completion time of 567s and bug reports of screen stalls.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Companion Progress
sign_in.body: Log in to safely pair your pet traits and account data.

guard.reason: Redesigns sign-in screen into a compact layout while maintaining required functionality.

candidates.score_note: Layout reframe for sign-in stall backed by funnel and user reports.

candidates.title: Pet Naming and Personality Setup Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a brand new pet setup screen after choosing a pet where users configure the pet's name and primary mood.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the highest funnel drop-off (conversion only 60.9%) and takes over 1000s on average.

new_pet_naming.headline: Name Your New Friend
new_pet_naming.body: Give your desktop pet a unique name and pick their personality.

guard.reason: 'new_pet_naming.components[0]': inputs may only ask for the pet's name

candidates.title: Photo Upload Guidelines & Requirements Hint
candidates.change: Display a explicit quality hint and step counter on the photo upload screen explaining photo framing rules.
candidates.why: Users submitted support tickets reporting custom pet generation failures and misaligned results.

upload_photos.hint: Upload well-lit photos showing a clear face for accurate AI pet generation.

guard.reason: Asks for personal photos showing the user's face

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Confirmation Flow
candidates.change: Transform the adoption certificate step into a stage layout complete with confirmation checklist components.
candidates.why: Adoption stage is the biggest bottleneck in the onboarding funnel with 39.1% drop-off.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Review your pet details and stamp the official adoption agreement.

guard.reason: Adoption certificate components replace the required official stamp with a badge.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Spawn Status Notification Switch
candidates.change: Turn on ready notifications on the waiting screen so users get alerted when their pet successfully renders on the desktop screen.
candidates.why: Users report that pets fail to show up on desktop or app stalls, leading to home median wait of 201s and high mean wait.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet Habitat
waiting.body: We are setting up your pet on your desktop screen. We will notify you when it appears.

guard.reason: Adds ready notification setting on waiting screen while keeping pet creation status.

candidates.score_note: Notification config change addressing reported rendering stalls.

candidates.title: Desktop Preparation Progress Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated desktop environment initialization screen with dynamic progress bar while waiting for asset generation.
candidates.why: The waiting/home step drops 18.7% of users and has an extreme mean time of 2336s.

new_prep_status.headline: Initializing Desktop Pet
new_prep_status.body: Configuring overlay permissions and loading pet graphics...

guard.reason: Adds initialization progress screen to waiting flow without skipping required steps.

candidates.score_note: High effort new screen with weak historical evidence for new flows.

candidates.title: Quick Control Tips on Welcome Intro
candidates.change: Add clear guidance hints directly on home_intro explaining basic mouse shortcuts to interact with or minimize the desktop pet.
candidates.why: 35.2% drop off at finish step and support emails highlight post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control or hide pets.

home_intro.hint: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick controls, minimize, or feed it!

guard.reason: Adds shortcut control tips to home intro overlay within onboarding bounds.

candidates.score_note: High impact step supported by emails, implemented via safe hints.

held_by_harm_budget: Account Persistence and Sync Warning Note
Quick Control Tips on Welcome Intro
lessons_next: Evidence for specific kinds of changes remains thin, as every category currently has only one test.
Predictions were mostly too high, except in round 5 where the effect was underpredicted.
No clear effect was seen for reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder).
No clear effect was seen for introducing new flows on the home screen (home, new_flow).
No clear effect was seen for redesigns in adoption (adoption, redesign) or path selection (choose_path, redesign).
Redesigning the finish step (finish, redesign) significantly hurt performance.
